props.author: KillaXBT
props.text:
This cycle is likely to be the one where $BTC never breaks back below the blue band.

Every time BTC has reclaimed the blue band and held above it, it has marked a major trend shift that led to significant upside.

So far, there's no compelling reason to believe this cycle will be any different.

Technical reinforcement on HTF-bullish BTC thesis. Chart shows bear-market-floor price models (STH-MVRV band); KillaXBT validating that holding above this technical level historically marked major trend shifts. Aligns with ongoing 2x swing long conviction (62.6K entry, HTF hold targeting 160K+) and spot DCA accumulation plan.
